title: sanguisorba minor subsp. anceps
intro: Sanguisorba minor subsp. anceps, commonly known as Red-veined Burnet, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family that is native to Europe. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Red-veined Burnet include its ability to stop bleeding, reduce fever, and treat digestive issues, making it a valuable medicinal plant in traditional herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Red-veined Burnet include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
